change.pipeline: Parse/profile and initial width-1 predictions, then full portfolio ranking/building during model wait.
change.seeds: AllGather doubling at minimum legal split; AllReduce doubling, maximum-legal-split rs_ag and minimum-split tree when permitted.
change.prompt: Initial predictions are explicitly marked as seeds. Current bytes/alignment, directed-link counts, missing/unequal reverse bandwidths and bandwidth range are included.
change.cache_ownership: Portfolio ranking/building completes before model proposals are evaluated. The model consumes a serialized prompt.
change.unchanged: Communication solver, complete portfolio search space, build count, one model call, 6-second model budget, 120 output tokens and 100-ms repair search.

new_coverage: Proposal evaluation waits for cache owner
Reverse bandwidth change outside initial routes appears in model prompt

baseline_profiling.note: A separate cold planning measurement; compare pipeline HTTP results below for end-to-end benefit.

model.request_difference: 0.2.6 sends initial seeds and current link statistics instead of the six full-search predictions.
model.quality_limit: Controlled replies test execution equivalence and whether a model proposal can win. They cannot establish real-model decision quality.

checks: 64 valid complete responses, one SDK model call each and no model or portfolio errors
32 pairs have the same built candidate configurations, source attribution and pre-refinement Replay selection
32 pairs preserve per-round action/src/dst/chunk multisets and round counts
Bandwidth/resource/reverse-direction mutations retain task ID while changing current-input hashes and model prompt content
Every adopted repair lowers its own pre-repair communication time and does not increase selection cost
The model-only configuration improves selection on mesh2d_ar in both public repeats
http_comparison.order: Two public repeats with version order reversed per case and repeat; four mutation pairs; one warmup pair excluded.
http_comparison.p95_method: Inclusive linear interpolation over 28 public HTTP requests per version.
http_comparison.communication_note: The 100-ms wall-clock repair search is unchanged. Different trial counts can change final Replay estimates even when pre-repair selection is identical.

Prompt byte count grew; real-model input-token count, latency and inference cost were not measured.
